import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Define source file paths
    source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_30/test_0.csv"
    source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_30/test_1.csv"
    
    # Define target output path
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_30/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    
    # Load Source 0: ['userId', 'movieId', 'tag', 'timestamp']
    df_source0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path)
    # Ensure correct dtypes
    df_source0['userId'] = df_source0['userId'].astype(int)
    df_source0['movieId'] = df_source0['movieId'].astype(int)
    df_source0['tag'] = df_source0['tag'].astype(str)
    df_source0['timestamp'] = df_source0['timestamp'].astype(int)
    
    # Load Source 1: ['movieId', 'title', 'genres']
    df_source1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path)
    # Ensure correct dtypes
    df_source1['movieId'] = df_source1['movieId'].astype(int)
    df_source1['title'] = df_source1['title'].astype(str)
    df_source1['genres'] = df_source1['genres'].astype(str)
    
    # Join Source 0 and Source 1 on movieId to get all columns for target
    # Source0 has userId, tag, timestamp; Source1 has title, genres
    df_merged = pd.merge(df_source0, df_source1, on='movieId', how='inner')
    
    # Reorder columns to match target schema:
    # ['movieId': int, 'title': str, 'genres': str, 'userId': int, 'tag': str, 'timestamp': int]
    df_target = df_merged[['movieId', 'title', 'genres', 'userId', 'tag', 'timestamp']]
    
    # Validate dtypes explicitly for target schema
    df_target['movieId'] = df_target['movieId'].astype(int)
    df_target['title'] = df_target['title'].astype(str)
    df_target['genres'] = df_target['genres'].astype(str)
    df_target['userId'] = df_target['userId'].astype(int)
    df_target['tag'] = df_target['tag'].astype(str)
    df_target['timestamp'] = df_target['timestamp'].astype(int)
    
    # Save to target CSV
    df_target.to_csv(target_path, index=False)
    
    print(f"Transformation complete. Output saved to {target_path}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
